annotations.title: SEC Filings Linked to a VC Firm

description: For a firm in the Mode VC Investor Atlas, returns Form ADV adviser records matched to it, recent Form D filings that name its partners, and a recent-activity roll-up. Every match carries a tier: "confirmed" matches are the only verified links; "probable" and "possible" are weaker signals and are hidden unless include_weak_matches is true. Returns "dataset not available yet" until Mode VC has loaded the data.

firm.description: Atlas firm slug or name, e.g. "alumni-ventures".

include_weak_matches.description: Also return probable and possible matches. Default false.

name: get_firm_filings
